report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry contradicts the alert: metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 70ms, zero dependency timeouts and zero db pool waiters; logs show 200/ok. Only one trace span shows an ERROR calling order (999ms), which alone cannot establish a bounded root cause. No downstream service telemetry, deployment facts, or memory-retention data are available. Handing off for downstream evidence.
missing_evidence: Order service traces, metrics and logs for the same window to confirm or refute downstream latency
Payment, inventory and postgresql dependency telemetry to localize the 999ms order call
Gateway error-rate and p95 metrics over a longer window to reconcile with the alert
Deployment records for gateway/order in the incident window
Memory-retention series per service to assess memory-leak hypothesis
